fullText.simplified:
第三十四章、选择你的原因

    十五里不太远，不一会儿车就停了下来。大家下了车，脚下是一片沙漠。放眼望去，除了被风吹起来的沙子，似乎没有什么特别的了。
    “怎么回事？是不是我们哪里判断错了？”简西说道。
    王长林裹了裹身上的衣服，说：“先别急，大家以此为原点，四下散开找找，看有没有什么发现。”
    扎格布尔也同意王长林的话，说：“大家两人为一队，分散往不同的方向查看，有情况立即大声呼救或者用手电筒的光源示意。”
    简西和石文谦一队，他们艰难地在沙地里走着。石文谦走在前面，简西走在后面。
    “文谦，你说我们能找到宝藏吗？”简西问道。
    “不知道啊，希望能吧。找不到就当这趟旅程是探险了，也挺有意思，谁说每次研究就一定会有成果，每次探险就一定会带回去宝贝呢？”这儿夜里的温度确实低，石文谦说话都带出了白气。
    简西笑笑说：“这就是我喜欢你的原因，也是我选择你的原因。你这个人啊，认真、聪明、执着，但是一点儿也不功利。”
    “选择我？你是指在我宿舍门上留下通知，让我提早半个小时去316号特窟吗？你从那个时候就开始选择我了？”石文谦对简西的说法并不感到意外。
    这倒是让简西惊讶了，说：“你……你都猜到了？！”
    “还有密室的暗门也是你打开的吧，你早就知道那儿有个密室，也知道打开暗门的机关在哪儿，对不对？”石文谦又补充道。
    “原来你早就知道了。”简西不好意思地低下了头。
    “开始的时候我只是怀疑，但是看你这一路积极的表现，特别是到了河洛村以后，就更明显了。之后又听你说了你们家族的秘密，我也就猜个八九不离十了吧。”石文谦轻描淡写地说道，也没有怪简西的意思。
    简西抱歉地说道：“对不起，文谦，原谅我没能一开始就告诉你一切。我在敦煌做记者，就是为了等316号特窟开放。我从爷爷的笔记本上知道，秘密就在密室的壁画上，那是我们家族的前辈留下的。为了探索这个秘密，我需要一个像你这样的人的帮助。我知道你是新来的考古研究员，我也读过你以前发表的研究成果，我判断你就是我可以合作的人，所以……”
    “好了好了，我也没生你的气。”石文谦打断了简西。
    “啊！——”后面突然传来简西一声大叫。
    “怎么了？”石文谦马上回头，却没有看见简西。他立刻用手电筒往周围照了照，离他大约一米的地方有一处塌陷！简西呢？难道简西掉下去了？
fullText.traditional:
第三十四章、選擇你的原因

    十五里不太遠，不一會兒車就停了下來。大家下了車，腳下是一片沙漠。放眼望去，除了被風吹起來的沙子，似乎沒有什麼特別的了。
    “怎麼回事？是不是我們哪裡判斷錯了？”簡西說道。
    王長林裹了裹身上的衣服，說：“先別急，大家以此為原點，四下散開找找，看有沒有什麼發現。”
    札格布爾也同意王長林的話，說：“大家兩人為一隊，分散往不同的方向查看，有情況立即大聲呼救或者用手電筒的光源示意。”
    簡西和石文謙一隊，他們艱難地在沙地裡走著。石文謙走在前面，簡西走在後面。
    “文謙，你說我們能找到寶藏嗎？”簡西問道。
    “不知道啊，希望能吧。找不到就當這趟旅程是探險了，也挺有意思，誰說每次研究就一定會有成果，每次探險就一定會帶回去寶貝呢？”這兒夜裡的溫度確實低，石文謙說話都帶出了白氣。
    簡西笑笑說：“這就是我喜歡你的原因，也是我選擇你的原因。你這個人啊，認真、聰明、執著，但是一點兒也不功利。”
    “選擇我？你是指在我宿舍門上留下通知，讓我提早半個小時去316號特窟嗎？你從那個時候就開始選擇我了？”石文謙對簡西的說法並不感到意外。
    這倒是讓簡西驚訝了，說：“你……你都猜到了？！”
    “還有密室的暗門也是你打開的吧，你早就知道那兒有個密室，也知道打開暗門的機關在哪兒，對不對？”石文謙又補充道。
    “原來你早就知道了。”簡西不好意思地低下了頭。
    “開始的時候我只是懷疑，但是看你這一路積極的表現，特別是到了河洛村以後，就更明顯了。之後又聽你說了你們家族的秘密，我也就猜個八九不離十了吧。”石文謙輕描淡寫地說道，也沒有怪簡西的意思。
    簡西抱歉地說道：“對不起，文謙，原諒我沒能一開始就告訴你一切。我在敦煌做記者，就是為了等316號特窟開放。我從爺爺的筆記本上知道，秘密就在密室的壁畫上，那是我們家族的前輩留下的。為了探索這個秘密，我需要一個像你這樣的人的幫助。我知道你是新來的考古研究員，我也讀過你以前發表的研究成果，我判斷你就是我可以合作的人，所以……”
    “好了好了，我也沒生你的氣。”石文謙打斷了簡西。
    “啊！——”後面突然傳來簡西一聲大叫。
    “怎麼了？”石文謙馬上回頭，卻沒有看見簡西。他立刻用手電筒往周圍照了照，離他大約一米的地方有一處塌陷！簡西呢？難道簡西掉下去了？

sentences.simplified: 我知道你是新来的考古研究员，我也读过你以前发表的研究成果，
sentences.traditional: 我知道你是新來的考古研究員，我也讀過你以前發表的研究成果，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ shì xīn lái de kǎo gǔ yán jiū yuán wǒ yě dú guò nǐ yǐ qián fā biǎo de yán jiū chéng guǒ
sentences.english: I knew that you were a new archaeologist, and I had also read your previously published research results.

sentences.simplified: 我判断你就是我可以合作的人，所以……”
sentences.traditional: 我判斷你就是我可以合作的人，所以……”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ pàn duàn nǐ jiù shì wǒ kě yǐ hé zuò de rén suǒ yǐ
sentences.english: I deemed that you were the person that I could collaborate with, so …”

sentences.simplified: “好了好了，我也没生你的气。”石文谦打断了简西。
sentences.traditional: “好了好了，我也沒生你的氣。”石文謙打斷了簡西。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo le hǎo le wǒ yě méi shēng nǐ de qì shí wén qiān dǎ duàn le jiǎn xī
sentences.english: “Alright, alright, I’m not even mad at you.” Shi Wenqian interrupted Jian Xi.

sentences.simplified: “啊！——”后面突然传来简西一声大叫。
sentences.traditional: “啊！——”後面突然傳來簡西一聲大叫。
sentences.pinyin: a hòu miàn tū rán chuán lái jiǎn xī yì shēng dà jiào
sentences.english: “Ah!” Suddenly, a loud shout from Jian Xi came from behind.

sentences.simplified: “怎么了？”石文谦马上回头，却没有看见简西。
sentences.traditional: “怎麼了？”石文謙馬上回頭，卻沒有看見簡西。
sentences.pinyin: zěn me le shí wén qiān mǎ shàng huí tóu què méi yǒu kàn jiàn jiǎn xī
sentences.english: “What happened?” Shi Wenqian turned around immediately, but he didn’t see Jian Xi.

sentences.simplified: 他立刻用手电筒往周围照了照，离他大约一米的地方有一处塌陷！
sentences.traditional: 他立刻用手電筒往周圍照了照，離他大約一米的地方有一處塌陷！
sentences.pinyin: tā lì kè yòng shǒu diàn tǒng wǎng zhōu wéi zhào le zhào lí tā dà yuē yì mǐ de dì fang yǒu yí chù tā xiàn
sentences.english: He immediately shined his flashlight and looked around. About a meter away from him, there was a sinkhole in the ground!

sentences.simplified: 简西呢？难道简西掉下去了？
sentences.traditional: 簡西呢？難道簡西掉下去了？

sentences.english: Where was Jian Xi? Could it be that Jian Xi fell in?

sentence_translations: Chapter 34: Why I Chose You
Fifteen li wasn’t too far. After a short while, the cars stopped.
Everyone got out of the cars, and beneath their feet was a desert.
Looking around, apart from the sand blown up by the wind, there didn’t seem to be anything special.
“What’s going on? Did we make a mistake somewhere?” Jian Xi said.
Wang Changlin wrapped his clothes around himself and said, ..
.. “Don’t panic. Everyone, let’s use this as a starting point, and then spread out to look around and see if we can find anything.”
Zhage Bu’er also agreed with Wang Changlin.
He said, “Everyone pair up, and then split off to check in different directions.
If there’s something going on, immediately shout for help or signal with the light of your flashlight.”
Jian Xi and Shi Wenqian formed a team. They walked through the sand with difficulty.
Shi Wenqian walked in front, and Jian Xi walked behind.
“Wenqian, do you think we can find the hidden treasure?” Jian Xi asked.
“I don’t know, I hope so.
If we don’t find it, let’s just treat this journey as an adventure, which has also been quite interesting.
Who says that every research project will definitely yield results, or that every adventure will definitely bring back treasure?”
The temperature here at night was indeed low. Shi Wenqian’s breath turned white as he spoke.
Jian Xi smiled and said, “This is why I like you, and also why I chose you.
You are earnest, intelligent, and persistent, but not at all utilitarian.”
“Chose me? Are you referring to the notice left on my dormitory door, asking me to go to Special Cave No. 316 half an hour early?
You first chose me then?” Shi Wenqian was actually not surprised by what Jian Xi was saying.
This, on the other hand, surprised Jian Xi. She said, “You … you had already guessed?!”
“It was also you who opened the hidden door to the secret chamber, right?
You knew long ago that there was a secret chamber there, ..
.. and you also knew where the mechanism to open the hidden door was, right?” Shi Wenqian added.
“So you knew all along.” Jian Xi lowered her head in embarrassment.
“At the beginning, I just suspected it.
But seeing how eager you looked, especially after arriving at Heluo Village, it became even more obvious.
And then, hearing you talk about your family’s secrets, I pretty much guessed it all.”
Shi Wenqian mentioned this casually, without any intention of blaming Jian Xi.
Jian Xi said apologetically, “I’m sorry, Wenqian. Forgive me for not telling you everything from the beginning.
I worked as a reporter in Dunhuang just to wait for the opening of Special Cave No. 316.
I learned from my grandfather’s notebook that the secret is on the mural in the secret chamber. It was left by my family’s ancestors.
In order to explore this secret, I needed the help of someone like you.
I knew that you were a new archaeologist, and I had also read your previously published research results.
I deemed that you were the person that I could collaborate with, so …”
“Alright, alright, I’m not even mad at you.” Shi Wenqian interrupted Jian Xi.
“Ah!” Suddenly, a loud shout from Jian Xi came from behind.
“What happened?” Shi Wenqian turned around immediately, but he didn’t see Jian Xi.
He immediately shined his flashlight and looked around. About a meter away from him, there was a sinkhole in the ground!
Where was Jian Xi? Could it be that Jian Xi fell in?
